composition: wall-top rhythm should break the box silhouette without becoming a second fortification system
pavilion studies remain above or behind existing perimeter walls
patina is selective and asymmetrical rather than a uniform dirt overlay
high cloth introduces household softness without occupying walk height
distant foliage interrupts the hard skyline and provides depth
warm distant openings appear only in golden-hour/evening presentation presets
invariants: no collision, navigation, economy, journal, receipt, clock or save authority
all skyline structures remain visually peripheral to childhood routes
no religious building or named historical structure is asserted
patina and pavilion placement are authored visual grammar, not measured reconstruction
